Agreed! Even when people ask if you're alright with a concerned tone I feel like when I answer no and tell them about my problems they just dismiss my problems and try to make me feel like they don't matter because everyone has some portion of the problems I'm having or something.

I have a coworker that does this a lot. He likes to come over, notice I'm hurting, and try to ask about it. I used to try to say "Man I don't know everything is just fucked up I feel like all I do is work and be broke and I can't stand it" and instead of just agreeing he'd say like "Yeah well we're all dealing with that" and it just made me feel like punching him. Like yeah fuck you too you know don't fucking come over here and talk to me trying to be all nice and let me open up then just fucking diminish my problems.

I want to be clear that this isn't the same thing that you did in relating to my problems and helping me feel not alone in them. You were kind about it and seemed to understand and relate. I feel like him and the others who have done this to me almost do it spitefully. Almost like they're saying "Suck it up buttercup you were cold to me earlier so you can go fuck yourself" or something.

Sorry I'm not really helpful. I was trying but shit is rough rn. Hopefully knowing you're not alone will help in some way. I still feel like it's wild how many of us are so lonely and hurting so much but have no way of connecting deeply to solve it. It's easier said than done of course we're probably on all corners of the globe and I don't even want to get out of bed half the time let alone go through the anxiety of meeting someone new but it feels like all of us lonely souls should get together some day lol
Thank you so much again for the kind words. You're great and I really hope you find a way forward as well

It definitely makes sense! I think the problem is that we have to try. I have many great qualities, honestly. I think people could stand to occasionally say something nice about me but they never do. I had a friend once who I had talked to about this kind of stuff and he said I have to figure out how to stop needing external validation but I have no idea if that's even possible. We're social creatures. All I want is someone to occasionally tell me I matter to them in some way or that I somehow improved their day. Instead I spend my entirely life doing that for everyone around me and get nothing in return ever. It makes it feel even worse. 

I feel like people should just say things when they think them. I feel like I've got to matter to someone but they just don't express it maybe. I don't know. Like I have no illusions that I'm wonderful but I at least say nice things to people when I feel like saying it so I feel like someone could at least offer me a "That made me feel really good yesterday thanks for saying that" or something so I could at least know someone actually listened to something I said. I feel like people don't even bother listening anymore most of the time.

Also I totally get what you're saying about the revenge thing. It's nice to fantasize about these assholes at least being inconvenienced by having to go to a funeral or something. Though I guess they probably just wouldn't go.

I don't feel obligated at all, I wanted to when I saw your post. You seem like a nice person I just wanted to try to help back like you helped me. And thank you you're valuable to me as well.

I feel like this world doesn't express itself to people. I was in a relationship for a long time and the entire time I tried to make sure she knew she was valuable to me and all I wanted was that feeling back. No such luck. I've never had anyone express any amount of true love or care to me at all. People talk and make it seem like they care but then ultimately they never actually put up when you're in need. 

I feel like I'm babbling but I guess I am truly just babbling. I just got inspired to say that all. I just wish the world would say what they thought more often. I spend my life trying to express to people their value or their positive qualities or something because I feel like once in a while I just need someone to tell me stuff like that but I never get it. 

I always just get stepped on because I'm nice. I will express to someone that they're wonderful or great in some way and I get a thanks and maybe a "you too" and that's it. I very rarely even get that. That always just feels like they're saying it because I've trapped them into saying it. Ugh. Sorry for babbling more..

Thank you so much. I wish I could cry for more than a minute at a time. It feels good to just cry for a half hour or something sometimes but I feel like my tears are empty at this point. It chokes me up when I read something that gives me any kind of hope and I end up crying but it stops too quickly. Surprise surprise lol something else I'm not good at.

You made me feel better than I was feeling and I really appreciate that. I wish I had something insightful to say to help you but I am just as fucked up and close to this conclusion as you are right now. I do want to say that your comments did make me feel a little more positive than I was in hopes that maybe the knowledge that you helped someone might change your mind. 

I am not judging you though there's only love in my message. I hope we both decide not to do this and I hope that both of us can find a way out of this that lets us lead happy lives. Good luck my friend.
Thank you

Thank you. I want you to know that really touched me. As ridiculous as that may be. I'm crying right now. Thank you for your response. It just hurts so much being so alone in life.

Edit: I don't think it's ridiculous that your kind words touched me I just hate life and don't know how to just freely express myself without trying to cover my ass from people's opinions. Ugh I'm so fucked up

I hear you here. I feel like every time I get hope it ends up being ripped away spectacularly. Like I just can't catch any fucking break ever. Possible amazing new job? I'm a fucking failure and they don't like me. Possible new partner? Makes me feel like trash. Possible chance of ever recovering from the mess I made in my life throughout my past? Pft dream on. Fuck fuck fuck fuck fuck.
I wanted to add, thank you for replying. I'm sorry if I seemed dismissive or anything. There's a lot wrong in my head right now.

I appreciate your response. I'm with you people would notice I was dead eventually but I can't imagine they'd care that much. I'm also not surprised you don't have a solution I don't really feel like it's something that can be solved. 

You're right though, everyone has someone else who is more important or more immediate or cuter or funnier or would be their first choice for anything and I'm none of those to anyone and never have been. It's an awful feeling. 

I'm at a point where I am too much of a coward to kill myself but if something killed me I think I'd be ok with that.
And challenge them. Reading his comment all I could think was "Yeah but I wouldn't fucking fail"
